steps.title: Run and talk to Chancellor Hassan …
steps.text: Run and talk to Chancellor Hassan to finish Prince Ali Rescue. — File:Minigame_icon.png Prepare a Clan wars teleport.

steps.title: File:Bank_icon.png Talk to the Banker (Ferox …
steps.text: File:Bank_icon.png Talk to the Banker (Ferox Enclave). — Deposit: Silverlight key. — Withdraw: Orange dye, Blue dye, Bronze med helm, Iron chainbody, Cabbage, Cadava berry, Chronicle, (1-3) Wine — {{Inventory |Orange dye |Blue dye |Bronze med helm |Iron chainbody |Cabbage |Cadava berries |Chronicle |Jug of wine | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | }}

steps.title: Run south-west through the wilderness, to …
steps.text: Run south-west through the wilderness, to the wilderness ditch west of the Black knights' fortress. — Equip File:Bronze_med_helm.png Bronze med helm File:Iron_chainbody.png Iron chainbody.

steps.title: Go to the Black Knights' Fortress.
steps.text: Go to the Black Knights' Fortress.

steps.title: Drink the wine as needed in …
steps.text: Drink the wine as needed in the black knights' fortress. — Black Knights have a max hit of 4.

steps.title: Enter castle and follow hidden route …
steps.text: Enter castle and follow hidden route through the north wall to listen at the grate.

steps.title: Go back to the main entrance …
steps.text: Go back to the main entrance and follow the east path to drop the cabbage in the hole.

steps.title: Exit the Black Knights' Fortress. — …
steps.text: Exit the Black Knights' Fortress. — File:Tap-to-drop_mode.png Drop File:Bronze_med_helm.png bronze med helm File:Iron_chainbody.png iron chainbody.

steps.title: Run directly west from the fortress …
steps.text: Run directly west from the fortress past the wilderness ditch and down the west side of the Goblin Village to get to the Goblin Village.

steps.title: Pick up 3 goblin mail. Locations: …
steps.text: Pick up 3 goblin mail. Locations: Up ladder, in mid-left hut, behind generals' hut(right side).

steps.title: Dye 1 body blue and 1 …
steps.text: Dye 1 body blue and 1 body orange.

steps.title: Start Goblin Diplomacy by talking to …
steps.text: Start Goblin Diplomacy by talking to generals.

steps.title: Use the armour on the generals …
steps.text: Use the armour on the generals and watch the cutscenes - orange, then blue, then brown. — You can right click and select the goblin mails while in the cutscene — File:Tap-to-drop_mode.png Drop File:Gold_bar.png gold bar.

steps.title: Speak to Sir Amik Varze to …
steps.text: Speak to Sir Amik Varze to complete Black Knights' Fortress.

steps.title: File:Skull_(status)_icon.png Deathwarp using the White knights …
steps.text: File:Skull_(status)_icon.png Deathwarp using the White knights on the top floor.
